sets.title: วันสัมภาษณ์งาน

model.say: Last Monday was supposed to be the most important day of Kitti's life, because he had finally received a letter inviting him to a job interview at a large bank in the city.
Unfortunately, as soon as he stepped out of his apartment, it started to pour with rain, and his old umbrella, which he had used for years, broke in the strong wind.
Since he did not want to arrive soaking wet, he decided to take the bus instead of walking.
However, the bus was so crowded that he could hardly breathe.
While he was standing there, he tried to call the company to say he might be late, but his phone had a dead battery because he had forgotten to charge it the night before.
When he finally got off the bus, he was completely lost.
Fortunately, an elderly woman who noticed that he looked worried offered to help him.
Not only did she show him the way, but she also lent him her umbrella.
To thank her, Kitti promised to buy her a drink after the interview.
Eventually, he arrived just in time, and the interview went surprisingly well.
Later that afternoon, he met the woman at a small coffee shop near the bank, where he told her the good news: he had got the job.
In the end, a terrible morning turned into one of the best days of his life.

sets.title: เค้กวันเกิดของแม่

model.say: Last Saturday, Nipa, who was a second-year student, wanted to buy a birthday cake for her mother.
As soon as she stepped out of the house, it started to rain heavily, so she ran to the train station to stay dry.
While she was waiting for the train, she noticed a wallet on the ground.
Although she was in a hurry, she took it to the station office.
Fortunately, the owner, an elderly man, arrived at that moment.
Not only did he thank her, but he also took a photo of her with his old camera.
As a result, she arrived at the bakery late.
However, the last cake, which had chocolate on top, was still there.
When she got home, her dog was so excited that it almost knocked the cake over.
In the end, her mother laughed and said it was the best birthday ever.

sets.title: เช้าวันสอบปลายภาค

model.say: Last Friday, Wichai, who was studying for his final exam, woke up late because his alarm clock did not ring.
As soon as he jumped out of bed, he grabbed his books and rode his bicycle to the university.
Unfortunately, the front tyre went flat halfway there, so he had to push his bike.
While he was walking, he got lost and had to check a paper map.
Suddenly, he saw an old man who had fallen off his motorbike.
Although he was already late, Wichai stopped and took the man to a hospital nearby.
As a result, he missed the first hour of the exam.
Fortunately, his teacher understood the situation and let him take the exam the next day.
In the end, the old man's family visited Wichai with a wrapped gift to thank him.

sets.title: คอนเสิร์ตที่เกือบพลาด

model.say: Last month, Kitti, who played the guitar in a student band, wanted to see his favourite band in concert.
As soon as he bought a concert ticket online, he saved it on his laptop.
While he was driving to the concert hall, he got stuck in a terrible traffic jam.
Unfortunately, he arrived after the gates had closed, so he waited outside feeling disappointed.
Fortunately, a staff member who knew him from the coffee shop near campus let him in.
Not only did he enjoy the show, but he also got to play the guitar on stage for one song.
In the end, he was so excited that he almost lost his keys on the way home.
